Name: powershell.exe
CommandLine:
"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'hf.*download.*openai-community/gpt2' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 'results/v6/preflight/gpt2_download_processes_before.json'"
